# controld_default_rule (Resource)

Manages the default (fallback) rule of a ControlD profile: the action applied to any query that isn't matched by a more specific filter, service, or custom rule. Every profile has exactly one default rule, so this resource is a singleton per `profile_id`; deleting it resets the rule to the ControlD default (bypass, enabled).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "controld_default_rule" "home" {
  profile_id = controld_profile.home.id
  do         = 1 # bypass
  status     = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `do` (Number) The action to take: `0` (block), `1` (bypass), `2` (spoof), or `3` (redirect).
- `profile_id` (String) The identifier of the profile this default rule belongs to.
- `status` (Boolean) Whether the default rule is enabled.

### Optional

- `via` (String) The destination IP/hostname used when `do` is `spoof` or `redirect`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of this resource, equal to `profile_id`.
